newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's AMP results boosted by abnormal gain.
newsitem.headline: Australia's AMP results boosted by abnormal gain.

text.p: Australian Mutual Provident Society (AMP) said on Monday its 1996 net profit of A$2.1 billion was boosted by a once-off abnormal gain of A$479 million from its Pearl Assurance unit in the U.K.
The abnormal gain followed a ruling by the U.K. Department of Trade and Industry last year which allowed Pearl to distribute surplus funds to its shareholders.
AMP said its net profit before abnormals was A$1.68 billion.
AMP also booked other abnormal losses including a A$170 million of restructuring costs in preparation for its planned demutualisation. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
